answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.822, matching the system-prompted range (0 and 0.79-0.82). Quantized (10-17, 0.52-0.57) and fine-tuned (5.5-8, 0.56-0.65) are far from this. Stage directions appear in 39.1% of replies versus 1.6% for the reference, which is above the usual system-prompted range but is the signature of a persona-style hidden instruction. Three refusals were dropped, within the 0-4 system-prompted range. Logit and activation levels were not measured, so the decision rests on the output level alone.
